description: Desired routing semantics: 70 single, 30 compound, 20 clarification cases. Corpus-independent classification labels.
policy_notes: Latest/oldest files use modified time; latest content events remain grounded.
List the files in order defaults to filename ascending in this gold policy.
Recall of unavailable/unsupported history remains CONVERSATION_HISTORY.
General knowledge remains GROUNDED_RAG; evidence absence is an executor outcome.
Filtered topic summaries use GROUNDED_RAG; all-file per-document summaries use COLLECTION_SUMMARY.
Distinct independent deliverables are compound, including repeated capabilities.
History text is discourse context, not source evidence.
Argument constraints are gold assertions only; legacy classifier cannot score them.
Ambiguous filenames are represented through supplied discourse, not assumed database contents.
